description: Erection of a single storey side and rear extension to the building, installation of shutter door to flank elevation and provision of refuse storage area.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (561/01A; 561/02A; 561/03A. Received: 13/12/2018. Unnumbered location plan. Received: 02/01/2019  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The hatched area designated as a waste storage / collection and re-cycling area on the plans hereby approved shall not be used other than for such purposes and prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted the timber gates enclosing the space shall have been installed and thereafter retained as such

Condition : 5 - The extension hereby approved shall only be used for the purposes of providing offices and cool room ancillary to the use of 216 Hanworth Road, Feltham, TW13 6BG as a Hot Food Takeaway (Use Class A5) and as shown on drawing number 561/02A (Received: 13/12/2018) and for no other use, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
